Async Event Handling Architecture: Designed an API Gateway with Fast API and Redis Queue for asynchronous log handling. Safety Guardrails & Incident Escalation: Engineered a custom Rule Engine to filter incoming anomaly triggers, enforce security guardrails, and automatically escalate critical security incidents to human analysts. Forensic Context Packaging & Monitoring: Automated context extraction onto a Streamlit dashboard featuring real-time system metrics and operational monitoring.

Developed an AI-assisted recruiter co-pilot (Fast API & Next.js) using Multi-Agent Orchestration and Tool/Function Calling to automate CV screening, candidate evaluation, and report generation. Implemented crucial system guardrails, including strict schema verification, PII masking for data privacy, and fallback strategies for insufficient contexts. Established automated evaluation metrics focusing on LLM faithfulness, relevance, and latency to continuously optimize prompts and template performance.
